units.source_text: 名人是在一月十五日到达热海的，十八日就猝然长逝了。

en.t: The Master arrived at Atami on January 15, and on the 18th he suddenly passed away.

units.source_text: 好像特地到热海来作古似的。

en.t: It was as though he had come all the way to Atami expressly to die.

units.source_text: 十六日我曾到旅馆造访名人，并下了两盘棋。

en.t: On the 16th, I visited the Master at his inn and played two games of shogi with him.

units.source_text: 当天傍晚，我回家不久，名人突然发病了。

en.t: That evening, not long after I returned home, the Master was suddenly taken ill.

units.source_text: 这是名人最后一次同我下他所爱好的将棋。

en.t: That was the last time the Master played the shogi he loved with me.

units.source_text: 我撰写过一篇秀哉名人最后一场比赛（告别赛）的观战记，

en.t: I had written an account of watching Master Shusai's final match, his farewell game,

units.source_text: 还同名人最后对弈了一盘，拍了一张名人最后的头像（遗容）。

en.t: and I also played one last game with the Master and took his final portrait, his deathbed likeness.
